Easy Crock Pot Chili
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:23am

Ingredients




4 cans lite kidney beans
2 lbs. hamburger
4 cans tomato soup
2 cans stewed tomatoes
2 med. onions
2 tablespoons chili powder
2 teaspoons salt
1 teaspoon paprika
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
3 bay leaves
1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper (optional)

Preparation

1 Brown hamburger with chopped onions; drain and mix with all other ingredients in large crock pot. Cook overnight or turn on in the morning for a tasty but simple chili meal. Great served over minute rice or with Fritos and shredded cheese. (This recipe tastes just as good in regular cook pot cooked on low for 4 to 5 hours.) Serves 8 to 10.
